verdict.rationale: The product's own repo says the whole app runs on your own computer using your own Claude Code or Codex. It ships an install script with a setup check (`cd app && npm run doctor`) and environment-variable configuration such as BUILDERS/MAX_AGENTS and optional API keys, so self-hosting is the default way to run it. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on confirmation of a local install, no stated open-source license, and no detail on server or multi-user deployment beyond a single local machine.
